Content.Text: TCU Server has been updated to 1.4.6.0.
While we prepare a pretty huge update behind the scenes, we bring you a long-awaited fix for an issue that has been plaguing the game and every PC player for a decade.
▸ The game bug left in the game by the developers that lowers your windows audio volume since CAU [2016] has finally been fixed. Good job, r00t0!
▸ Fixed crash when viewing leaderboards in the result menu.
▸ Fixed leaderboards not updating live when getting a new high score.
